Zarude

Dark Grass

Galar · Generation 8 · Mythical Pokémon

Zarude is a Dark/Grass-type Rogue Monkey Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 70 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 600.
